concept: Review and integration: boundaries as an ongoing practice of self-respect across every relationship
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across boundaries with authority, recognizing manipulation, and modeling for others — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what healthy boundaries mean to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
